author: GamingBolt
description:
Control Resonant is nearly here (or out today, if you're playing on PS5 with the Digital Deluxe Edition). If you've experienced any Remedy game, you know an adventure unlike many others awaits. This time is no different - even with so many connections to the original, there are several new systems and progression mechanics to play around with. Manhattan opens up after the first hour or so, which can also be overwhelming.

Never fear, though. We have 15 tips and tricks to help you survive and lay the smackdown on the Hiss, Mold and whatever the Patterning throws at you next.
title: Control Resonant - 15 Things It DOESN'T TELL YOU

author: GamingBolt
description:
EA Sports FC 27 is definitely somewhat uneven with some of its bigger additions, but in other, rather critical areas, it does manage to make several meaningful improvements. Career mode in particular sees some long overdue improvements with transfers in particular, while the on pitch gameplay is also suitably addictive and enjoyable in the state that the game has launched. 

The Grounds could definitely do with significant post launch upgrades, from new content to crucial layers of gameplay polish, but by and large, FC 27 feels like a much needed change up for EA’s stagnating football series.
title: EA Sports FC 27 Review - The Final Verdict
